title: Once Upon A Time In Middle East

title_lang.en: Once Upon A Time In Middle East

synopsis:
Xu Fu (Shen Teng), a chef from Northeast China, heads to the Middle East to work at a Chinese restaurant. Carrying his wok, he hopes to support his family and pay off his debts. He serves up classic Chinese dishes: the Dragon‑Raising‑Its‑Head feast, candied sweet potatoes and Kung Pao chicken. He partners with restaurant manager Ma Junsheng (Jiang Qiming): Xu Fu handles the cooking, while Ma Junsheng takes care of guests. Together, they turn the little‑known Dragon Restaurant into a thriving spot.


War soon breaks out, and local conditions quickly turn dangerous. Different armed groups clash across the region. What will happen to Xu Fu? Can Dragon Restaurant survive amid the chaos of war?

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 東北大廚徐福（沈騰 飾）為養家還債，扛著炒鍋跑去中東一家中餐館做廚師。他亮出龍抬頭、拔絲地瓜、宮保雞丁等各色中華美食，和前台經理馬俊生（蔣奇明 飾）一個掌勺一個攬客，把無人問津的龍餐館經營得風生水起！然而戰爭突然爆發，當地局勢急轉直下。亂世之中，各方勢力輪番登場，徐福的命運將會何去何從？戰火中的龍餐館又將如何維繫？
